name: ReversePhoneLookup.com
instructions: Open https://www.reversephonelookup.com/ and click "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information" at the bottom. Enter {contact_email} and one of these numbers (digits only if it complains): {all_phones}. Finish the robot check and submit; we'll click the confirmation link it emails. Repeat for each number, then press "I've done this".
notes: Takes about 3 to 7 days after the email is confirmed.
source: Steps per ClearNym's ReversePhoneLookup opt-out guide.
